env._NOTE_DB: Database lives at .opencode/skills/system-skill-advisor/mcp-server/database/skill-graph.sqlite by default; SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DB_DIR overrides, with SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DB_DIR as a legacy fallback (both still recognized by the launcher + handlers).
env._NOTE_MEMORY_DB_PATH: createChildEnv() pins the advisor child's embedder-pointer resolution (which DB's active_embedder_* row gets read) to this package's own skill-graph.sqlite. An ambient MEMORY_DB_PATH is never honored as an override, since any other owner of that generic name would silently misroute the advisor's embedder selection to a foreign database. Tests/CI only: SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_MEMORY_DB_PATH overrides the pin. See db_path_policy.md §4.
env._NOTE_THRESHOLDS: Advisor confidence/uncertainty thresholds are tunable: SPECKIT_ADVISOR_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (default 0.8), SPECKIT_ADVISOR_UNCERTAINTY_THRESHOLD (default 0.35). Lane weights tunable via SPECKIT_ADVISOR_LANE_WEIGHTS_JSON + SPECKIT_ADVISOR_LANE_SHADOW_WEIGHTS_JSON (partial-merge JSON, post-022/011/4b).
env._NOTE_DOC_TRIGGERS: Opt-in doc-frontmatter harvest: skill_graph_scan ingests references/assets trigger_phrases into skill_docs and advisor_recommend returns matchedDocs pointers (dampened derived-lane signal). Default-off in code; enabled for this repo. Unset/false to roll back.
env._NOTE_TRUST_DEFAULT: Daemon-owner trust grant for mutation tools (advisor_rebuild, skill_graph_scan, skill_graph_propagate_enhances). Callers whose _meta omits transport/trust markers default to UNTRUSTED unless this is 'trusted'. Native MCP clients (e.g. /doctor repair flows) send no _meta, so this grant keeps them working; remove it to fail-closed on every transport-absent caller. Explicit _meta trusted:false / callerAuthority:'untrusted' is always rejected.
env._NOTE_HF_EMBED_SOCKET: hf-local model-server socket. The advisor is the sole owner: it arms the resident nomic server spawn by default (SPECKIT_SKILL_ADVISOR_MODEL_SERVER_ENABLED=0 turns that off) and attaches to whatever already listens here. Short /tmp path stays under the macOS sun_path 104-char limit.
